strategy: Every 5 trading days, hold the top 5 assets by momentum score (0.6×20-day + 0.4×5-day return, trend bonus, RSI>75 penalty) that are above their 50-day average; max 2 single stocks; equal slots; the rest in cash.

assumptions.fees: $0 commissions; regulatory sell fees not modeled
assumptions.data: Alpaca IEX daily bars, split+dividend adjusted
